unityHints.esquireNote: After exporting clips, build prefabs in oldenera_factions under Assets/CustomUnits/esquire/ and run BuildCustomUnitBundles with ../../custom_prefab_pipeline/custom_units_manifest.json

oldenEraBattlePrefab.renderer: MeshRenderer on a built-in Quad (or plane), not SpriteRenderer
oldenEraBattlePrefab.reason: Battle uses the same 3D forward path as stock units; SpriteRenderer is not reliable there.
